newsitem.title: USA: Court tells Phelps Dodge to rescind sale.
newsitem.headline: Court tells Phelps Dodge to rescind sale.

text.p: Phelps Dodge Corp said Friday the U.S. District Court of the Eastern District of New York ruled last month that the company's 1986 sale of property in the New York City borough of Queens to the United States Postal Service was to be rescinded.

The court ordered the company to return the $14.8 million originally paid by the Postal Service for the property and to pay interest on the sales price for a portion of the time since that sale, Phelps Dodge said.
The company said it has not yet determined whether to appeal the court's decision.
As a precaution, however, the company recorded interest charges of $5.9 million and reclamation reserves of $10.0 million in the 1996 fourth quarter. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
